sections.title: Section 1: Car Rental Inquiry
sections.html:
inquiry

(noun). sự hỏi (về ai, về cái gì)

I have been making a lot of inquiries about my bill for Shopee

quotation

(noun). bản dự trù giá

We’ll give you a quotation for replacing your windows.

latter

(adjective). sau cùng

He chose the latter option.

caravan

(noun). nhà lưu động

The farmer lets holiday caravans park on his land.

mileage

(noun). tổng số dặm đã đi

My annual mileage is about 10 000.

take something into consideration

(verb). xét tới, tính đến

They will take the benefits of selling their petshop into consideration

van

(noun). xe hàng, xe tải

She usually sleeps in the back of the van.

twin

(noun). đôi

My twin sister and I have the same nose.

stove

(noun). cái lò

She put a pan of water on the stove.

bedding

(noun). chăn chiếu

This is the best bedding for a good sleep

pillow

(noun). cái gối

Do you like this pillow?

blanket

(noun). mền, chăn

It’s cold tonight—can I have another blanket?

heater

(noun). bếp lò, lò (để sưởi, hâm thức ăn…)

Even with the heater full on, it's still cold.

pick up

(verb). cho (ai) đi nhờ xe; cho xe đến đón ai

The bus picks up passengers on the street.

insurance

(noun). bảo hiểm

All the stolen items were covered by insurance.

licence

(noun). giấy phép; bằng

Applicants must hold a driving licence.

issue

(verb). phát, phân phát

A newspaper has just been issued

sections.title: Section 2: Harvesting And Processing Cocoa Beans
sections.html:
harvest

(noun). việc thu hoạch; việc gặt

Farmers are extremely busy during the harvest.

botanist

(noun). nhà thực vật học

A botanist announced a new and beautiful plant

constituent

(noun). hợp thành, cấu thành

Vitamins are natural food constituents which help you have good health.

expose

(verb). phơi bày ra, để lộ ra

She smiled, exposing a set of white teeth.

pulp

(noun). cơm, thịt (của trái cây)

The pulp is usually removed from fruit juice

rind

(noun). vỏ (quả cam, quả chanh), cùi (pho-mát)

The rind of a fruit such as a lemon or orange is its thick skin

heap

(noun). đống

His clothes lay in a heap on the floor.

grate

(noun). vỉ lò, ghi lò (lò sưởi)

A huge fire was burning in the grate.

liquefy

(verb). [làm cho] hóa lỏng

The cheese had liquefied so we poured it over the bread.

ferment

(verb). [làm] lên men

Vegetables are fermented.

trickle

(verb). [làm cho] chảy ri rỉ

Tears were trickling down.

pod

(noun). vỏ

The part that cover the nuts is called a pod

split

(verb). tách ra

The teacher split the class into groups.

rigorously

(adverb). [một cách] khắt khe

We don't know whether the drug works or not until it is rigorously tested

sort

(verb). sắp xếp, xếp loại, phân hạng

Rubbish can easily be separated and sorted into plastics, glass and paper.

hopper

(noun). cái phễu

She used the hopper to fill the bottle with water

chamber

(noun). khoang rỗng, kín của máy

A human heart has four chambers.

tread (trodden)

(verb). giậm, đạp

I kept treading on his toes when we were dancing

shuffle

(verb). xáo trộn

You have to shuffle the cards before playing

sprinkle

(verb). rải, rắc, rảy

She sprinkled sugar over the strawberries.

polish

(noun). sự đánh bóng

I'll just give my shoes a quick polish

mold

(noun). mốc

There's mold on the cheese.

crack

(verb). bẻ, nứt ra, vỡ

The ice cracked as I stepped onto it.

roasted

(adjective). được rang

Coffee beans are roasted

sealed

(adjective). được bịt kín

These letters are carefully sealed

flavour

(noun). mùi vì

For me, these are the best flavours

obvious

(adjective). hiển nhiên, rõ ràng

It's obvious that he loves her

mild

(adjective). nhẹ, không quá gắt

A mild chilli sauce is suitable for him

original

(adjective). nguyên bản

The original Mickey Mouse is on the left-hand side of the picture

raw

(adjective). sống, chưa chín

Can you go to the market and order a completely raw steak?

strictly

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Photography is strictly forbidden

smoky

(adjective). có vị khói

The chicken has a nice smoky flavor

slightly

(adverb). ở một mức độ không đáng kể

She's slightly taller than her sister.

come across

(verb). tình cờ gặp

She came across some old photographs

qualify

(verb). đủ điều kiện cho

To be qualified for getting the driving license, you need to be over 18

brew

(verb). pha cà phê, ủ cà phê

He brewed some coffee.

pressure

(noun). áp lực, áp suất

There is intense pressure on her.

grind

(verb). nghiền nát, xay nát

When coffee is grinded, its shape is the same as the one on the last spoon

concentrated

(adjective). đặc, cô đặc

I bought a can of concentrated milk

sections.title: Section 3: The Moa
sections.html:
species

(noun). loài (số nhiều)

There are many species of animals in the forest

flightless

(adjective). không bay được

The ostrich is a flightless bird

endemic

(adjective). đặc hữu, chỉ có đặc biệt ở nơi nào đó

Koala is endemic to Oceania

ecosystem

(noun). hệ sinh thái

Pollution can have a negative effect on the ecosystem.

extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

The giant panda will soon become extinct.

disappear

(verb). biến mất

Dinosaurs disappeared forever

fossil

(noun). hóa thạch

Dinosaur fossils are being kept at the museum

mysterious

(adjective). thần bí

The existence of aliens is very mysterious

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

It is difficult for me to distinguish Chinese, Japanese and Korean

in relation to

(adverb). so với

Let's see how big an orange is in relation to an apple

lack

(verb). thiếu, không có

He lacks money

chick

(noun). con

Chicks are very lovely

lay

(verb). đẻ trứng

The chicken lays the eggs

incubate=hatch

(verb). ấp trứng

The chicken is incubating the eggs

possibility

(noun). khả năng

There is a possibility that the war between China and America may happen.

catch sight of

(verb). nhìn thấy

Someone might catch sight of the Loch Ness monster

amazed

(adjective). bất ngờ

She was amazed when she saw the news.

claim

(verb). chắc chắn, quả quyết

She claims that she is telling the truth

reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

He was a very reliable and honest man

evidence

(noun). bằng chứng

Hair is usually used as an evidence to find out who is the murderer

predator

(noun). thú ăn thịt

Lions are predators

horrible

(adjective). kinh khủng

For me, these clothes are horrible

feature

(noun). nét đặc trưng

An interesting feature of the city is the old market.

markedly

(adverb). một cách hiển nhiên

Markedly, we don't want to spend too much money.

remote

(adjective). hẻo lánh

They are living in a remote area

interior

(noun). đất liền nằm sâu vào trong (một nước...), nội địa

The storm will go from the sea to the interior of our country

rare

(adjective). hiếm

Diamonds are so rare, which is why they are expensive

identify

(verb). nhận biết

Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.

skull

(noun). xương sọ

This is a human's skull

reveal

(verb). tiết lộ

The magic tricks has been revealed

remarkable

(adjective). xuất sắc, đáng chú ý

The Vaccine for Covid-19 is a remarkable achievement of the humankind

narrow

(adjective). hẹp, chật hẹp

What a narrow street!

resonant

(adjective). vang dội

You will be a good singer if your voice is as resonant as Whitney Houston

sections.title: Section 4: History Of Time-Measurement
sections.html:
primitive

(adjective). nguyên thủy; ban sơ

The conditions at the campsite were rather primitive.

encounter

(verb). gặp; đụng độ với

We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

grasp

(verb). hiểu rõ, nắm vững

He was unable to grasp how to do it.

slip through somebody's fingers

(verb). tuột mất, bị bỏ lỡ (một cơ hội…)

He let the chance of winning slips through his fingers

recourse

(noun). sự cầu đến, sự nhờ vào

Giving the money to the thieves is a recourse to him when they asked him for money

motion

(noun). sự chuyển động

The motion of the ship was making me feel seasick.

reflection

(noun). sự suy nghĩ; điều suy nghĩ

They took a few minutes to offer their personal reflections.

heaven

(noun). bầu trời, khoảng trời

Four tall trees stretched up to the heavens.

shadow

(noun). bóng

He sat under the shadow of a tree

breeding

(noun). sự sinh sản

We used to keep pigs for breeding purposes.

migration

(noun). sự di trú

Migrations are hard to control

precise

(adjective). đúng; chính xác

Are the measurements precise enough?

ritual

(noun). trình tự hành lễ; nghi lễ

It takes several days to complete the ritual.

religion

(noun). tôn giáo, đạo; tín ngưỡng

I believe in God, but I don't belong to any religion.

date back

(verb). cách diễn đạt chỉ một việc gì đã diễn ra trong quá khứ

This fashion dates back hundreds of years.

sundial

(noun). đồng hồ mặt trời

It is a sundial

vary

(verb). thay đổi, biến thiên

Bread price varies widely

rely

(verb). tin vào, dựa vào

I know I can rely on my best friend

receptacle

(noun). thùng, đồ đựng

Residents are given many receptacles for their rubbish

variation

(noun). sự dao động, sự biến thiên

Global temperature variations over the last 140 years

glass-blowing

(noun). thổi thủy tinh

I love watching glass-blowing

sandglass

(noun). đồng hồ cát

Such a beautiful sandglass

wax

(noun). sáp nến

The wax falls down the side of the candle

influence

(verb). tác động

Thủy Tiên has influenced the community through her charity work
